{{Top}}
'''Organ replacement''' was a technology that thrived on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It consisted of replacing worn-out organs with technological counterparts, or sometimes cloned organs. Organ replacement was the reason Bakurans lived much longer than [[Human/Legends|Humans]] elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. For example, [[Eppie Belden]] was young enough to personally lead a guerrilla uprising at the age of 132. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] was versed in organ replacement surgery. In addition, [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] was occasionally used for the process of creating fresh organs to replace defective organs, as a means to ensure that the people undergoing the procedure did not reject the new organs.

The monks of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] regularly had their brains removed and placed into droids known as [[B'omarr brain walker|B'omarr brain walkers]], allowing them to continue pondering the mysteries of the universe after their physical bodies died.<ref name="SOT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref><ref name="BibTale">{{StoryCite|story=Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref><ref name="Gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}}</ref><ref name="S&L">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref><ref name="GoF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Brain Spiders]]''</ref>
